1.web: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.
1.asv: Brethren, even if a man be overtaken in any trespass, ye who are spiritual, restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

2.web: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
2.asv: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

3.web: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
3.asv: For if a man thinketh himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

4.web: But let each man test his own work, and then he will take pride in himself and not in his neighbor.
4.asv: But let each man prove his own work, and then shall he have his glorying in regard of himself alone, and not of his neighbor.

5.web: For each man will bear his own burden.
5.asv: For each man shall bear his own burden.

6.web: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.
6.asv: But let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

7.web: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
7.asv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

8.web: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.
8.asv: For he that soweth unto his own flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth unto the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap eternal life.

9.web: Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.
9.asv: And let us not be weary in well-doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

10.web: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
10.asv: So then, as we have opportunity, let us work that which is good toward all men, and especially toward them that are of the household of the faith.

11.web: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.
11.asv: See with how large letters I write unto you with mine own hand.

12.web: As many as desire to look good in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
12.asv: As many as desire to make a fair show in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

13.web: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.
13.asv: For not even they who receive circumcision do themselves keep the law; but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

14.web: But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
14.asv: But far be it from me to glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world hath been crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

15.web: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
15.asv: For neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

16.web: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.
16.asv: And as many as shall walk by this rule, peace be upon them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

17.web: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
17.asv: Henceforth let no man trouble me; for I bear branded on my body the marks of Jesus.

18.web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
18.asv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brethren. Amen.
